title: LG Studio — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for LG Studio.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Designed to Inspire." Premium tier. LG Studio is the premium tier of the LG lineup — pro-style design, UltraHeat cooktop burners, and upgraded materials. It bridges the gap between standard LG and ultra-premium LG SIGNATURE. Studio features the same smart platform but with better finishes, more powerful burners, and design details that elevate the kitchen.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Customers who love LG but want a more premium look. Mid-luxury kitchen remodels.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for LG Studio:

• UltraHeat burners for pro-level cooking power

• Pro-style design with heavy-duty handles and knobs

• Same ThinQ smart platform as all LG but with premium finishes

• Bridges the gap between mass-market LG and ultra-premium SIGNATURE

• Strong value vs KitchenAid and Cafe at similar design level
